purpose: Comparar la distribución Rehire frente a su complemento y la attrition voluntaria trailing 12 meses en la cohorte más reciente de agosto.

definition.population: Active Regular Employees at the 24-Aug-2025 fiscal-August closing snapshot
definition.grain: Deduplicated employee cohort at the baseline snapshot
definition.complement_rule: Not a rehire = baseline is_rehire is not 1, including null stored values

acceptance_rule: Both displayed cohorts have n>=30, one baseline row per employee, and voluntary exits / baseline cohort reconciles to the trailing-12-month rate.
